title: Mezcla y desigualdad
goal: Read about a demographic reality the racial hierarchy couldn't keep up with, and the genuinely bizarre 1795 decree that let wealthy mixed-race people legally purchase reclassification as 'white'.

items: State roughly how large the 'casta' population had become by the late 18th century.
Explain what that mechanism reveals about the concept of race in this period.
Explain whether inequality decreased as mixing increased.
Use 'a lo largo de', 'a raíz de' and 'como consecuencia de' in a single formal paragraph.
